title: Canonical base lock record (T21, spec 17.15 / 17.28 / 17.29)
description: Extension of the T02 SourceRecord for the single source_kind=canonical-base entry (reverse-skill mother framework). All 17 T02 SourceRecord fields stay required with their frozen enums; this schema only adds the T21 base-lock fields. scripts/verify-canonical-base-lock.py enforces the required subset with the standard library.

id.description: The canonical base has exactly one record id.

source_url.description: Honest origin URL read from the snapshot remote (snapshot remote.origin.url carried a .git suffix; the record follows the registry convention without it). Never invented: if the snapshot has no remote, this field must be null and the verifier reports the gap instead of passing.

commit.description: Baseline commit of the mother framework; must equal baseline_commit and registry baseline.commit.

tree_digest.description: Frozen contract skills-hub/importer-digest/1 over scan root '.', .git included (same convention T12 measured for the four community sources; verified byte-identical by recomputation).

source_manifest.description: Pointer to the offline-verifiable manifest section, currently docs/community/CANONICAL-BASE-LOCK.md#attestation. No second manifest copy is stored, so the record and the document cannot drift apart.

snapshot_root.description: Relative snapshot path resolved as <repo>/snapshot_root, else <repo>/../snapshot_root (the snapshot lives outside the fusion repo per spec 1.4).

integration_commit.description: Fusion-repo commit this base record is pinned against; must resolve via git cat-file -e where .git is present.

present.description: False today: no verifiable signature exists for any candidate. Claiming true without one is forbidden.

status.description: unsigned today. signed-verified additionally requires signer, trust_root, key_id, signed_at plus rotation/revocation records.

trust_root.description: Null today: no trust root is implemented or distributed.

key_rotation.description: Rotation procedure reference, or the literal 'unimplemented'.

revocation.description: Revocation procedure reference, or the literal 'unimplemented'.

distribution.description: local-only while signature.present is false (17.15 digest-only local-only rule). A redistributable claim without a verifiable signature is refused with exit 20.
